Q6097.reason: Under the traditional view the grantor kept a reversion when he conveyed the fee tail, and conveying that reversion to the niece gives her the reversion; the team note rules out A, and D is wrong because she takes a future interest, not a present fee simple.

Q5137.reason: An expert may base an opinion on x-rays and data of a kind reasonably relied on in the field, so the testimony is admissible even though the x-rays are not in evidence.

Q5526.reason: Entering a hotel guest's room at night with intent to commit a crime inside (threatening him) is a breaking and entry of a dwelling with the required intent formed at entry.
